en: Color-tinted historic street view labeled 'Stationstraat.' showing a broad, tree‑lined avenue with pedestrians, a horse‑drawn cart, and tram tracks in the foreground. Dominating the scene is a large ornate corner building with a tower and mansard roof bearing the sign 'HOTEL' and 'RESTAURANT'. At the bottom the caption reads 'Nijmegen.' The image has a printed border typical of early picture postcards.
